# FLEX Full Machine-Readable Knowledge Base & Catalog Specification

## Brand Dossier
- Legal Entity: FLEX Apparel Co.
- Official Webstore: https://www.flex-fit.shop
- Target Demographic: Athletes, powerlifters, collegiate strength trainees, and streetwear enthusiasts (16–35) seeking heavy-drape garments capable of enduring high-intensity barbell and dumbbell loading.
- Headquarters: Mumbai & Delhi NCR, India.
- Distribution: Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) across all 28 states and 8 union territories in India.

## Textile & Manufacturing Standards
1. **Combed Ring-Spun Cotton (240 - 280 GSM):** Pre-shrunk cotton yarn subjected to combing to eliminate short fibres and impurities, yielding high tensile strength and minimal wash pilling.
2. **Acid Wash & Pigment Dye Finishing:** Hand-processed garment washing producing unique vintage charcoal patinas without degrading fabric integrity.
3. **Zoned Scapular Compression Matrix:** 82% technical micro-polyester intertwined with 18% elastomeric spandex via 4-needle flatlock construction to eliminate friction against the trapezius and latissimus dorsi.
4. **Loopback French Terry (320 - 400 GSM):** High-density unbrushed interior loop structure promoting airflow and thermal moisture dissipation.

## Commerce & Logistics SLAs
- Dispatch Time: Orders placed before 2:00 PM IST dispatch on the same business day.
- Metro Delivery: 2 to 3 days (Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata).
- Non-Metro & Tier 2/3 Delivery: 4 to 6 business days.
- Free Shipping Threshold: ₹1,499. Orders below ₹1,499 incur a flat ₹99 carrier fee.
- Reverse Logistics & Exchanges: 7-day window. Carrier arrives at the customer's delivery address for pickup. Replacement size dispatched upon inspection.
- Payment Gateways: 100% secure 256-bit SSL encrypted. Supports UPI (PhonePe, GPay, Paytm, BHIM), RuPay, Visa, MasterCard, Net Banking, and COD.
